up: Extract exact IC50 values (in nM) for compounds tested against the target with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL4662' (proteasome macropain subunit MB1). Return the compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, IC50 value, and the PubMed ID.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_nM,
  d.pubmed_id
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4662'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.standard_relation = '=';
